title: MQGT-SCF: Reproducible constraint lab for operational tests of a parameterized measurement deformation
description: MQGT-SCF is an open, reproducible constraint-lab pipeline that maps a parameterized operational hypothesis into observables and pressure-tests it against public experimental constraints across multiple channels. This release artifact includes code, scripts, and versioned outputs sufficient to reproduce the included tables/figures.
notes: This is a constraint lab for testing a parameterized hypothesis class. It does not claim confirmation of new physics; it provides an auditable instrument intended to be inspected, replicated, and falsified.
